article.title: Amy Winehouse musical in development for West End

article.content: Stage show based on late singer reportedly set to feature her best-loved songs with involvement from her father Mitch A musical based on Amy Winehouse is in development for London’s West End. The project is still in early stages with Catherine Schreiber, a Tony award-winning producer (Cabaret, Rent), attached to the project, according to Variety . Casting is reported to currently be under way. Continue reading...
